gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-cossette-texte: Technical and stretched, Nulshock lays out wide-spaced outline capitals that barely rise above its lowercase. But Cossette Texte carries paragraphs smoothly, its prominent x-height and wide-eyed e keeping a long run of text open.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-fresca: Stretched, widely spaced outline letters give Nulshock its technical stance. Fresca keeps its counters open to the outside and its ascenders short over big bowls, so paragraphs flow without calligraphic thinning.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-gafata: A laser-cut sheet look defines Nulshock, every outline traced at one cutting width and spaced out wide. Gafata's tall, short-stalked lowercase gives that wide display a tidy partner below.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-noto-sans-medefai: Noto Sans Medefaidrin reads tall and contemporary, its curves turning without ink pooling. Against that high-rising lowercase, Nulshock's stretched, bold outlines, free of any brush-like swelling, make the sharpest difference.
